facts.fact: The World Bank's digital economy diagnostic states that the central network of the government, partly hosted by CNIAPGE, does not extend to local government branches; it gives no date, so the document's published year is used.

The World Bank states that many ministries at the centre operate on manual systems and that this is more pronounced at the local level, for want of funds and adequate infrastructure, with data shared between ministries by hand, USB drive or e-mail; no date is given, so the document's published year is used.

systems.owner: the government, partly hosted by CNIAPGE
systems.tiers: ministries at the centre; stated not to extend to local government branches
central; no government cloud platform for all ministries yet
rolled out ad hoc by ministry; no tier stated

systems.platform: CDMA mobile network supplied by ZTE
systems.owner: GECOMSA, a joint venture of the government (51%) and ZTE (49%)

note: 'Local government branches' is the document's phrase and is not defined: it may mean municipalities or ministries' local offices. The two facts record a stated absence; the document names no local government office as connected.
